sources.snippet: Português (padrão) · English Fully offline PII (Personally Identifiable Information) detection and anonymization for PDFs, using the quantized ONNX build of bardsai/eu-pii-anonimization-multilang, running on CPU via ONNX Runtime. PII = any data that can identify a person (name, email, phone number, document number, health data, etc.).
